title: Packaged food lookup
summary: Label nutrition for branded products from Open Food Facts.
description: A packaged product has a label; an estimate of it is worse than reading it. Both the diary agent and the coach can look a product up in the free Open Food Facts database.

requirements.text: The diary agent and the coach can search Open Food Facts by product name or barcode.
Only the product name or the barcode is sent to Open Food Facts; never a photo or personal data.
Nutrients missing from the label are estimated by the model.
Label nutrition is mapped onto Tally's nutrient keys, per 100 g and per serving.
